title_zh: 按课堂规程准备探头演示

scenario.label_zh: 按课堂给定规程准备传感探头演示
scenario.goal_zh: 核对探头演示的操作分工并约定由教师调整设置

context_zh: 课堂沟通练习。学员 Sora 与教师 Daniel 依据本次课程的给定安全说明准备水温传感器演示。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: Is this the probe for the water-temperature demonstration?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: Yes. Leave it on the tray for now, and keep the protective screen in place.

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: The protocol on our worksheet says only the instructor changes the settings.

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: That's right. I'll handle the controls; you can read the display from your seat.

sentences.speaker: Sora
sentences.text: So I'll record the numbers when you tell me the sensor is ready?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.text: Exactly. We'll check the worksheet together before I begin.

targets.sense_zh: 用于探测或测量的探头
